parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the database. Valid values:

*   **Creating**
*   **Running**
*   **Deleting**

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Pages start from 1.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: 30.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-databases --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --db-name testDB01 --db-status Creating --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeDatabases --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --DBName testDB01 --DBStatus Creating
